title: Canonical-paths registry
description: Registry of canonical-vs-deprecated path strings used by path-canonical-ripple.ts. When a path is renamed/moved/canonicalized, add an entry here so the hook flags every surviving deprecated occurrence in the configured scope. The registry is the bookkeeping; the hook just enforces.

matcher.description: How deprecated[] entries are matched. 'literal' (default) uses git grep -F, a fixed-string substring match with no boundaries — the founding apps/desktop/ entry depends on that, since the no-trailing-slash form is what catches the executable/CLI shape. 'regex' uses git grep -E (POSIX ERE) for entries whose deprecated forms are multi-token command invocations needing boundaries or whitespace tolerance. Opt-in per entry, never a global flip. ERE only: no \b and no lookaround — git grep -E compiles through the platform regex engine and GNU extensions are not portable across the CI matrix.
